site_area_sqm.reason_for_confidence: SITE-001 is a maintainer-provided provisional_constraint (official_boundary=false, boundary_precision=provisional_rough); this is a mathematical result from submitted provisional geometry, not a trusted official area, and must be fully recalculated when an official SITE_BOUNDARY is published.

building_footprint_area_sqm.formula: sum(polygon_area(BLDG-ST01-001, BLDG-ST02-001, BLDG-ST03-001)) recomputed in EPSG:4548; the three envelopes do not overlap, so sum equals union
building_footprint_area_sqm.reason: This value is conceptual-envelope-only: the sum of three small agent-generated intervention envelopes (survey_status=pending_survey). It is not an existing-building footprint, GFA, or FAR quantity.

green_ratio.formula: union_area(GREEN-AXIS-001, GREEN-QINGHE-001, GREEN-XIAOYUE-001, GREEN-ST01-001, GREEN-ST02-001, GREEN-ST03-001) / site_area_sqm, both in EPSG:4548; the six concept polygons are drawn non-overlapping, so union equals sum

public_space_ratio.formula: union_area(N1..N6) / site_area_sqm, both in EPSG:4548; the six prototype polygons are drawn non-overlapping, so union equals sum

key_area_count.formula: count(features in key_areas.geojson: PROV-KEY-001, PROV-KEY-002, PROV-KEY-003)

station_count.formula: count(distinct station envelopes: BLDG-ST01-001, BLDG-ST02-001, BLDG-ST03-001, each sited inside one PROV-KEY-* provisional key area)

wing_count.formula: count(distinct wing corridors: ROAD-WING-TECH-001, ROAD-WING-XIAOYUE-001, each with a matching AI_SERVICE_ZONE catchment WING-TECH-001 / WING-XIAOYUE-001)

scenario_count.formula: count(distinct values in the union of properties.scenario_ids across N1..N6); S01-S10 all appear at least once

industry_test_count.formula: count(distinct scenario ids in the union of properties.scenario_ids across N1..N6 that also appear in properties.industry_test_scenario_ids: S08, S09, S10)

phase_count.formula: count(features in phasing.geojson: PHASE-001, PHASE-002, PHASE-003)

conceptual_mobility_length_m.formula: sum(line_length(ROAD-AXIS-001, ROAD-WING-TECH-001, ROAD-WING-XIAOYUE-001, ROAD-STITCH-N4, ROAD-STITCH-N5)) recomputed in EPSG:4548; lengths are summed (not unioned) because the five alignments are distinct, non-coincident line features with no shared segments to double-count

declared_reversible_prototype_ratio.formula: union_area(N1..N6 where properties.reversible == true) / union_area(N1..N6); all six submitted prototypes are marked reversible=true, so this equals 1.0 for the submitted design layer only
declared_reversible_prototype_ratio.reason: This is submitted design declaration coverage only (share of N1..N6 that declare reversible=true in this geometry layer), not measured operating performance, reversal history, or a governance commitment that reversal will occur.

declared_manual_fallback_documentation_r.formula: count(N1..N6 with a non-empty properties.manual_fallback) / count(N1..N6); all six submitted prototypes declare a manual/offline fallback field, so this equals 1.0 for the submitted design layer only
declared_manual_fallback_documentation_r.reason: This is submitted design documentation coverage only (share of N1..N6 with a non-empty manual_fallback field in this geometry layer), not measured operating performance, a staffing guarantee, or evidence that any fallback has been tested or authorized.

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls, official site boundary, and any total floor area (unknown — no floor count or GFA is claimed for the conceptual station envelopes) are not present in the public site package.
